QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_43

question.text: Under SAS-500, the Biodiversity-Impact indicator is BEST proxied by:

answer.text: Shannon Diversity Index or bird species count (pre-post) at the project site, cross-referenced with eBird / IBIN data

explanation.text: The Logic: Shannon Diversity Index is a validated ecological measure. Bird-call / species counts cross-checked with eBird / IBIN (India Biodiversity Information Network) gives SAS-500 defensible biodiversity evidence. The Trap: Options A, C, D are either narrow or tangential. Cross-Exam Context: Shannon Index is cited in SEBI BRSR biodiversity section (III-A / III-C Compliance). Assessor's Pro-Tip: A single-day ornithologist-led bird count at each site gives you low-cost biodiversity baseline. Budget ~Rs. 10,000 per site per day — worth it for the evidence weight.
